Expeditions

Goto Terminal Survey

Documenting the environment beneath the terminals

Location: Goto terminals, Bonaire.

Year: 2026.

Client: Rijkswaterstaat.

My role: underwater photogrammetry, imagery processing, inspection software, and technical reporting.

I surveyed beneath Bonaire’s Goto terminals in 2026 to document marine debris and reef condition, producing maps, reconstructions, and inspection tools.

The field assignment

Photogrammetry supported reconstruction and mapping of the underwater environment.

Survey outputs

I produced 3D reconstructions, orthomosaics, and technical reports documenting survey coverage and outputs.

I built a viewer and labeling tool for Rijkswaterstaat to inspect imagery and analyze debris.

Goto Survey Viewer: explore the inspection and labeling tool.
